The brief facts of the prosecution case is as follows:-
The case of the prosecution that the CW-2 is the victim in this case, aged about 83 years and she is a widow and she C.C.No.8182/2022 did not have children.
Her sister CW-1's daughter was looking after her till 2018.
Thereafter, she did not looked her for some personal reasons.
CW-2 was having the property bearing No.54/3, Geetha Mandir Road, 4th Cross, Sreeramapura, measuring 720 sq. feet which consists sheet house and the said house.
The CW-2 was registered will in the name of Sangeetha Trust in the year 1991-92.

On 10.07.2019 the accused No.3 deposited an amount of Rs.10 lakhs, on 15.07.2019 deposited an amount of Rs.5 lakhs to CW-2 account.
On 12.07.2019 the accused No.1 transferred an amount of Rs.10 lakhs to the C.C.No.8182/2022 accused No.2 from CW-2 account.
On 26.07.2019 the accused No.1 deposited Rs.5 lakhs through cheque to accused No.2 account.
Thereafter, the accused No.1 to 4 were shared the said amount and the accused have used the said amount for their personal use.

After completion of the amount in the CW-2 account on 13.07.2019 the accused No.1 and 2 were put CW-2 at old age home Akomen Labs at Mysore and mentioned in the agreement as she was suffering from Dimentia and the accused No.1 signed the said agreement.
Thereafter, the accused No.3 sold the said property to CW-3 wife name for an amount of Rs.55 lakhs through sale deed.

Thereafter, the accused No.3 demolished the said property by transporting the old items in the said house through Lorry other place and thereby the accused persons have committed the criminal breach of trust and cheated the complainant and committed the above offences.
